# `inconsistent-error-set-style`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a public error-returning function whose explicit or inferred error-set
style differs from the project majority.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Mixing styles gives neither stable explicit API contracts nor consistently low
ceremony.

## When it fires

At least 20 public error-returning functions and a 90% majority are required.
